sources.title: Ambessa Build Guide: “A wolf has no mercy” - Comprehensive guide for all levels to Ambessa

passive.name: Drakehound's Step
passive.text: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

spells.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
spells.text: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

spells.name: Repudiation
spells.text: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.text: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

spells.name: Public Execution
spells.text: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

damage.value: Ambessa deals physical burst damage with her RQE combo, especially with an assassin build.

archetype.value: Ambessa is a mobile carry fighter who can play as a bruiser or an assassin depending on her build.

winCondition.value: Ambessa wins by snowballing her lane into a strong mid game.

spikes.why: Ambessa starts to tank and out-trade opponents as her AD scaling and items come online.
Ambessa becomes harder to out-trade as her kit and AD scalings come together.

spikes.at: Q reaches a 10-second cooldown at max rank
spikes.why: Ambessa can sweep more often and enable more follow-up slams.

bait.why: Ambessa loses her main pick and engage tool when it is spent or misses.

mistakes.value: Ambessa cannot rely on autopilot in lane, even in easier matchups.
Ambessa cannot play lane on autopilot and expect to win it.
Ambessa misses Q’s follow-up slam if her first sweep does not strike an enemy.
